email.subject: MV VALDA CREST - Rotterdam line-up: berth occupied
email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV VALDA CREST - Rotterdam, Rijnmond Energy Coal Terminal

The coal berth is occupied. The vessel ahead is expected to complete discharge late on 26 Jan. VALDA CREST is next in line, berthing about 27 Jan 0600 UTC, subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned.

We will advise at once if the line-up changes. Please keep us informed of the vessel's ETA.

Best regards,
Operations desk
Maasport Agencies, Rotterdam

detail.text:
I've asked the voyage agent to assess Maasport Agencies' report that Rotterdam's coal berth is occupied, with VALDA CREST next in line to berth about 27 Jan 0600 UTC. The voyage optimisation service advises slowing to 8.3 knots, arriving Rotterdam 27 Jan 04:00 UTC, saving 31 anchor hours and 38.1 tonnes VLSFO. Because the ETA moves 31 hours against the 12-hour charterparty notice limit, an ETA notice to the agent and receiver is due. I have put the speed-order decision to you.

I am waiting for your yes/no before any draft or entry is prepared.

**Summary:** The port agent reports a berth delay in Rotterdam, with berthing expected about 27 Jan 0600 UTC. I have asked whether you want me to order MV VALDA CREST to slow to 8.3 knots, arriving 27 Jan 04:00 UTC; if yes, I will draft the ETA notice to agent and receiver and propose the port call ETA entry, with the Master's safety judgement overriding the speed order.
